proof_summary: At \(n=140\), bounding the relevant square roots by squaring shows \(\lfloor140\sqrt{5/4}\rfloor=156\), \(\lfloor144\sqrt{5/4}\rfloor=160\), \(\lfloor157\sqrt{5/4}\rfloor=175\), and \(\lfloor161\sqrt{5/4}\rfloor=180\). Hence the four terms are respectively \(471,484,528,542\), so the claimed right-hand side is \(528+484-471=541\neq542\).
